extension.description: Highlight CSV and TSV files, Run SQL-like queries
config.enable_sticky_header.description: Enable sticky header line at the top.
config.enable_separator_autodetection.de: Enable automatic content based separator autodetection.
config.autodetect_separators.description: Enable automatic content-based separator autodetection for the specified list of separators (multicharacter separators are supported).
config.autodetection_min_line_count.desc: Minimum number of non-comment lines in file for content-based autodetection.
config.highlight_rows.description: Highlight rows with alternate background colors by default.
config.virtual_alignment_mode.descriptio: Virtual alignment based on VSCode inlay hints that doesn't change underlying file content.
config.virtual_alignment_mode.disabled: Disabled. Align only when "VirtualAlign" command is executed
config.virtual_alignment_mode.manual: Align when "Align" Status Bar button is clicked
config.virtual_alignment_vertical_grid.d: Show vertical grid in virtual alignment mode.
config.enable_cursor_position_info.descr: Keyboard input text cursor: show info about the cursor CSV column in the status bar.
config.double_width_alignment.descriptio: If enabled treat double width unicode chars e.g. Chinese or Japanese chars as double wide when aligning.
config.enable_auto_csv_lint.description: Automatically run linter for every CSV file.
config.csv_lint_detect_trailing_spaces.d: CSV Lint: detect leading and trailing whitespaces in fields and show warning.
config.comment_prefix.description: Comment lines prefix, e.g. "#". Set to empty string to disable.
config.rbql_output_dir.description: Output directory for RBQL result sets, can be `TMP`, `INPUT` or a custom absolute path. `TMP` - output in system tmp dir(default), `INPUT` - output in the same dir as input file, otherwise use provided path as the output directory e.g. `/path/to/custom/dir`.
config.rbql_with_headers_by_default.desc: RBQL treats the first line as header by default.
config.rbql_strip_spaces.description: RBQL strips (trims) leading and trailing spaces from each field as a preprocessig step.
config.enable_context_menu_head.descript: Enable "Preview CSV head" option in File Explorer context menu for all files.
config.enable_context_menu_tail.descript: Enable "Preview CSV tail" option in File Explorer context menu for all files.
config.enable_debug_logging.description: Dev Mode: Enable Debug Logging. Run command [Developer: Show Logs...] -> [rainbow_csv_debug_channel] to see the output.
command.SetJoinTableName: Set join table name for RBQL
